title: Core terminal state and compact paged storage
constraints: Start exactly at base_commit and edit only the isolated candidate worktree.
Keep alacritty_terminal vendored source byte-frozen; use it only as behavioral reference or private parser/transition engine where appropriate.
Preserve the S1 public normalized snapshot and differential-corpus behavior; cleanly migrate every local caller for intentional API changes.
Common resident cell representation must have size_of::<Cell>() == 8; rare graphemes, styles, hyperlinks, and semantic metadata live in interned side tables.

History storage must be page-based rather than Vec<Row>; hot pages have a fixed capacity, cold pages compress in the background with LZ4, and cold resident allocations are released/decommitted after compression.
Compression work and completion queues are bounded; terminal mutation cannot block on compression and stale completion results cannot replace newer page generations.
No lossy eviction within configured history limits; decompression restores byte-identical cells and side-table identities.
Avoid per-cell heap allocation, per-feed whole-screen clones, and global locks in the mutation hot path.
No unsafe without a local SAFETY comment naming ownership, lifetime, alignment, bounds, and thread invariants.
No GUI launch. Skip formatting, builds, tests, lint, and benchmarks; lead owns validation. Commit once and report SHA.
behavior: Primary and alternate screens, cursor and saved cursor, origin/wrap/insert modes, scroll margins, tab stops, colors and styles.
Unicode width, double-width cells, grapheme clusters and combining marks without corrupting neighboring cells.
Index/reverse-index, scrolling, insert/delete chars and lines, erase operations, resize and reflow with cursor stability.
OSC 8 hyperlink identities, semantic prompt/output regions, and stable selection anchors across scroll and reflow.
DEC/ANSI modes represented deterministically in normalized snapshots.
Existing ANSI/DEC differential corpus remains byte-chunk invariant at every split point.
storage_api: Expose an 8-byte common Cell with content/style/flags encoded by compact IDs or equivalent checked representation.
Expose paged scrollback configuration and observable statistics: logical lines, hot resident bytes, compressed bytes, queued jobs, restored pages, and stale completions discarded.
Expose deterministic synchronous hooks for tests to drain compression and force page restoration without sleeps.
Bound every background channel explicitly and define overload behavior without losing terminal history.
Drop joins or cancels background compression workers without panic, leak, or detached work.
tests: All core terminal operations and primary/alternate screen transitions.
Wide, combining, emoji/grapheme, style interning, hyperlink and semantic-region round trips.
Page boundary scrolling, compression round trip, stale-generation rejection, bounded-queue overload, and clean worker shutdown.
Compile-time or runtime assertion that common Cell is exactly 8 bytes.
One-million-line deterministic stress fixture with bounded resident memory accounting and no logical-line loss.
Differential normalized snapshots against the checked-in Ghostty oracle corpus.
acceptance: one-million-line resident memory is bounded and no worse than the S0 oracle baseline
